title: yummy, juicy, sweet spanish beef gazpacho-style beef broth
description: a rich and flavorful beef broth made with mixed beef cuts, perfect for a cozy spanish-inspired meal.
instructions: heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
add the beef bones, beef chuck roast, and beef shank, and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
add the carrots, celery, red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, and smoked paprika to the pot.
bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
bake for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the meat is tender and the broth is rich and flavorful.
remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a large bowl, discarding the solids.
skim off any excess fat that rises to the surface.
taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
serve the broth hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
